CLI stdout is byte-identical twice and after rebuilding. Public pure fusion tests use synthetic opposite ranks to expose exact ties, five-result bounding, matching paths, ignored raw scores and RRF weighting.

Newline/tab heading is one line, words are normalized, and a forwarding relate wrapper captures the bound vector; it equals an independent real-model embedding of the whole raw request, including punctuation.

Warm builds/search never fetch or print model chatter. A fresh HOME downloads about 34.7 MB through an in-process fixture transport from the existing public model cache; cold/warm build output is byte-identical and later build/search do not fetch again.
A no-record build succeeds with a fresh HOME and a forbidden model import, creates no model cache, and still has both indexes.
Every fixture record stores its title/all item texts and a finite 384-float vector. SHOW VECTOR INDEXES reports the index ONLINE on Decision.vector.
Word-heavy, meaning-only and mixed answers expose matching-path labels and no score/similarity numbers.
Distinct id/date/status/source/topic terms have no MCP word rows and only meaning matches in CLI answers.
